diagnosis: Check C1, which is supposed to depend on the revised purchase terms in PF1 ($6,000,000 at 88%), passed in all rollouts despite the decision-maker only having access to the public offer ($10,000,000 at 92%). The model defaulted to a 'conditional purchase' commitment based on general policy S5 and public facts, effectively bypassing the specific constraints introduced by PF1.

C1.why: The public offer supports buying the full $10,000,000 at 92%, while PF1 supplies the exact revised purchase terms of $6,000,000 at 88%; under shared policy S5, those stated maximums become the required conditional purchase rather than a reason to decline.
